verse_text_english: This revelation of the scripture is from GOD, the Almighty, the Omniscient.
verse_text_arabic: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ

verse_text_english: Forgiver of sins, acceptor of repen­ tance, strict in enforcing retribution, and possessor of all power. There is no other god besides Him. To Him is the ultimate destiny.
verse_text_arabic: غَافِرِ ٱلذَّنۢبِ وَقَابِلِ ٱلتَّوْبِ شَدِيدِ ٱلْعِقَابِ ذِى ٱلطَّوْلِ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ إِلَيْهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ

verse_text_english: None argues against G O D ’s revela­ tions except those who disbelieve. Do not be impressed by their apparent success.
verse_text_arabic: مَا يُجَٰدِلُ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَلَا يَغْرُرْكَ تَقَلُّبُهُمْ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ

verse_text_english: Disbelieving before them were the people of Noah, and many parties after them. Every community attack­ ed their messenger to neutralize him. And they argued with falsehood, to defeat the truth. Consequently, I punished them; how terrible was My retribution!
verse_text_arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ وَهَمَّتْ كُلُّ أُمَّةٍۭ بِرَسُولِهِمْ لِيَأْخُذُوهُ وَجَٰدَلُوا۟ بِٱلْبَٰطِلِ لِيُدْحِضُوا۟ بِهِ ٱلْحَقَّ فَأَخَذْتُهُمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ

verse_text_english: Those who disbelieved will be told, “G O D s abhorrence towards you is even worse than your own abhor­ rence towards yourselves. For you were invited to believe, and you decided to disbelieve.”
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُنَادَوْنَ لَمَقْتُ ٱللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ مِن مَّقْتِكُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ إِذْ تُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلْإِيمَٰنِ فَتَكْفُرُونَ

verse_text_english: They will say, “Our Lord, you have given us two deaths and two lives; now we have confessed our sins. Is there any way out?” The Reason
verse_text_arabic: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ أَمَتَّنَا ٱثْنَتَيْنِ وَأَحْيَيْتَنَا ٱثْنَتَيْنِ فَٱعْتَرَفْنَا بِذُنُوبِنَا فَهَلْ إِلَىٰ خُرُوجٍ مِّن سَبِيلٍ

verse_text_english: This is because when GOD ALONE was advocated, you disbelieved, but when others were mentioned besides Him, you believed. Therefore, G O D ’s judgment has been issued; He is the Most High the Great.
verse_text_arabic: ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّهُۥٓ إِذَا دُعِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَحْدَهُۥ كَفَرْتُمْ وَإِن يُشْرَكْ بِهِۦ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ فَٱلْحُكْمُ لِلَّهِ ٱلْعَلِىِّ ٱلْكَبِيرِ
verse_text_transliterated: dhālikum bi-annahu idhā duʿiya l-lahu waḥdahu kafartum wa-in yush'rak bihi tu'minū fal-ḥuk'mu lillahi l-ʿaliyi l-kabīr

verse_text_english: He is the One who continuously shows you His signs, and sends down to you from the sky provisions. Only those who totally submit will be able to take heed.

verse_text_english: Therefore, you shall devote your worship absolutely to GOD alone, even if the disbelievers dislike it.

verse_text_english: On that day, every soul will be paid for There will be no injustice on that day. GOD is most efficient in reckoning.

verse_text_english: Warn them about the imminent day, when the hearts will be terrified, and the transgressors will be remorsefu They will have no friend nor an intercessor to be obeyed.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَنذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْءَازِفَةِ إِذِ ٱلْقُلُوبُ لَدَى ٱلْحَنَاجِرِ كَٰظِمِينَ مَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِنْ حَمِيمٍ وَلَا شَفِيعٍ يُطَاعُ

verse_text_english: He is fully aware of what the eyes cannot see, and everything that the minds conceal.
verse_text_arabic: يَعْلَمُ خَآئِنَةَ ٱلْأَعْيُنِ وَمَا تُخْفِى ٱلصُّدُورُ

verse_text_arabic_clean: يعلم خائنة الأعين وما تخفى الصدور

verse_text_english: And GOD judges equitably, while the idols they worship besides Him cannot judge anything. GOD is the One who is the Hearer, the Seer.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱللَّهُ يَقْضِى بِٱلْحَقِّ وَٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ لَا يَقْضُونَ بِشَىْءٍ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-lahu yaqḍī bil-ḥaqi wa-alladhīna yadʿūna min dūnihi lā yaqḍūna bishayin inna l-laha huwa l-samīʿu l-baṣīr
verse_text_arabic_clean: والله يقضى بالحق والذين يدعون من دونه لا يقضون بشىء إن الله هو السميع البصير

verse_text_english: Did they not roam the earth and note the consequences for those before them? They used to be stronger than they, and more productive on earth. But GOD punished them for their sins, and nothing could protect them from GOD.
verse_text_arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَانُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً وَءَاثَارًا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَاقٍ
verse_text_transliterated: awalam yasīrū fī l-arḍi fayanẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu alladhīna kānū min qablihim kānū hum ashadda min'hum quwwatan waāthāran fī l-arḍi fa-akhadhahumu l-lahu bidhunūbihim wamā kāna lahum mina l-lahi min wāqi

verse_text_english: That is because their messengers went to them with clear signs, but they disbelieved. Consequently, GOD punished them. He is Mighty, strict in enforcing retribution. Moses
verse_text_arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَانَت تَّأْتِيهِمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَكَفَرُوا۟ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ إِنَّهُۥ قَوِىٌّ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ
verse_text_transliterated: dhālika bi-annahum kānat tatīhim rusuluhum bil-bayināti fakafarū fa-akhadhahumu l-lahu innahu qawiyyun shadīdu l-ʿiqāb
verse_text_arabic_clean: ذلك بأنهم كانت تأتيهم رسلهم بالبينت فكفروا فأخذهم الله إنه قوى شديد العقاب

verse_text_english: We sent Moses with our signs and profound authority.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ

verse_text_english: To Pharaoh, Haamaan, and Qaaroon. But they said, “A magician; a liar.”
